_comment: Remote override for the allanime provider's volatile constants. Host this file somewhere raw (GitHub raw, a gist, any static URL) and point core/src/provider/allanime/constants.rs REMOTE_CONFIG_URL (or the ANIDOKU_ALLANIME_CONFIG_URL env var) at it. When allanime rotates its crypto, publish a new version here — installed apps self-heal on the next play attempt, no release required. Every field is optional and falls back to the baked-in default, so a rotation typically only needs build_id + qd_mask_hex; boot_label / boot_sig_template cover x-aa-boot scheme changes. This file is regenerated by scripts/allanime-oracle (npm run oracle) and is the live remote config for installed apps (constants.rs REMOTE_CONFIG_URL points at it on master). Underscore-prefixed keys are ignored.
